공통.빛: Light: the main ceiling lights are off; the room is lit only by warm tungsten practical lamps and candles, like old 2700K bulbs. It is dark and moody: most of the frame sits in deep warm-brown shadow, with soft amber pools of light around the lamps and candles. Colors stay warm amber, honey and brown — no red light, no pink or magenta light, no colored gels, no neon, no blue or teal tones.
공통.필름: Photorealistic film still with natural textures, slight film grain and natural lens falloff, as if shot handheld on a cinema camera. No text, no logos, no watermarks.
공통.세트_소파: Location: a Korean apartment living room late at night, set for a small night party of three home-shopping superfans. A long, low beige velvet sectional sofa with plump cushions runs along the back wall, and its right end turns toward the camera as an L. A leopard-print fleece blanket is draped over the right part of the sofa, and a cream faux-fur throw lies over the right armrest. In front of the sofa stands a low black coffee table with a crossed metal base, crowded with a night-party mess: lit pillar candles and tea lights, two wine bottles, stemmed glasses, a white fluffy fur cushion, a stack of clear plastic food-storage containers with pastel pink and mint lids, and a long curl of printed paper order receipts hanging over the table edge. A burgundy rug lies under the table on a warm wood-look floor. Behind the sofa, the left part of the back wall is a wide window with sheer white curtains and heavy beige drapes; through it, the lit windows of neighboring Korean apartment towers at night. On the back wall right of center hangs a vertical column of three small framed shadow boxes, each displaying a pastel-pink limited-edition food-container gift box like a collector's treasure, with a small dried-flower wreath beside them. In the right part of the room behind the sofa corner, on a low sideboard: a vintage table lamp whose pleated pink fabric shade glows warm amber, two red taper candles, and a string of tiny warm fairy lights draped along the sideboard and along the back of the sofa.
공통.세트_강도: Location: the other side of the same Korean apartment living room at night, facing away from the sofa toward the entrance. On the left, a white built-in wall cabinet with a deep ledge at chest height like a mantelpiece, holding a lit pillar candle in a glass holder and a small trailing plant, with the edge of a tall white bookshelf at the far left. Center-right, a closed white panel door to the hallway with a silver lever handle. On the wall to the right of the door, a black wrought-iron wall sconce holding a candle in a glass. Above the ledge, a round antique wall clock. White crown molding runs where the beige walls meet the shadowy ceiling. At the far right edge of the frame, a heavy beige curtain.
공통.세트_짧게: Location: the same Korean apartment living room as in Image {n}, late at night — the beige sectional sofa with the leopard-print blanket, the coffee table crowded with candles, wine glasses, pastel food-storage containers and paper order receipts, the curtained window, the framed shadow boxes, the pink-shaded lamp and the fairy lights.
